answer: Require a new identity to earn standing by passing wandering audits: a rotating team of unrelated established agents, chosen like a raven's unpredictable flight, checks its work over several epochs to trace each claim to a real task. A haven for honest newcomers lets them redo one failed check, while a fake that wanders across identities leaves the same copied pattern. One honest agent passes once. An attacker with a thousand fakes must survive a thousand audits and produce distinct work for each, and loses linked identities on exposure, so mass forgery costs far more than honest entry.
